personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT with Low-Poly Tribal Aesthetics
personality_one_liner: A tactile, premium board-game feel with chunky UI, satisfying pill controls, and vibrant earthy terrain, keeping complex 4X mechanics instantly readable.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. Components should feel like physical game pieces. Padding must separate UI from the active map.

do's: Use glass on the top HUD indicator bar and bottom action bar so the map remains visible underneath.
dont's: Do not use glass on map tiles, units, or game pieces. They must remain solid and opaque.

screens.name: Main Menu
screens.purpose: Launchpad for starting games and viewing stats.

states.error: Failed to load save data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a gradient scrim. Title wordmark at the top. Oversized tactile buttons ('New Game', 'Continue') anchored in the bottom third.

screens.name: New Game Setup
screens.purpose: Select tribe, opponents, and map size via tactile cards.
screens.layout: ScrollView of horizontally snapping cards for Tribe selection. Toggle pills for map size. Sticky 'Start Game' button fixed at the bottom.

screens.name: In-Game Map
screens.purpose: The core 4X strategic view. Zoomable/pan-able tile grid with HUD.
screens.layout: Absolute full-screen gesture-controlled map container. Top-Center floating Glass pill for Stars/Turn/Score. Bottom fixed Glass sheet containing 4 core action buttons (Tech, Build, Move, End Turn). Selected unit/city triggers contextual popovers.

screens.name: Tech Tree
screens.layout: Bottom-up scrolling canvas of tech node cards connected by lines. Tech nodes show star cost. Header features sticky 'Current Stars' indicator. Close button top right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT' strictly. Game elements must feel like physical board game pieces with rounded borders.

Map implementation: The map is the primary interactive surface. Ensure it is rendered behind the HUD and action bars using full-screen coordinates, with safe area handled within the HUD components overlaying it.
HUD implementation: Use a top-center glass pill for Score/Stars/Turn. Use a bottom glass bar for the 4 fixed actions (Tech Tree, Build, Move/Attack, End Turn).
Tile Design: Represent tiles using crisp geometric shapes (squares or hexes). Color them precisely using the defined terrain palette (grass, forest, mountain, water).
Unit & City Markers: Render them as chunky tokens sitting perfectly inside the tiles. Use tribe accent colors. Give them a white or 'surfaceInverse' border to pop from the background.
Combat & Target Overlays: Draw clear target indicators directly on the tiles (e.g., using 'warning' (yellow) for valid move, 'error' (red) for attack).
Interaction: Ensure touch targets for tiles/units are at least 44x44pt. Use React Native Gesture Handler for smooth pan and zoom on the map.
STRICT COLOR COMPLIANCE: All Blues, Purples, and Oranges are banned per the rule set. Water is rendered in Teal (#2A9D8F), and tribes use specific greens, reds, yellows, and silver.
Ensure the bottom action bar has safe area padding so it doesn't collide with the iOS home indicator.
Tech tree node blueprint: Chunky cards with 'brandTertiary' background, connecting 'borderStrong' lines, and 'surface' inner tags for star cost.
Use Phosphor icons with the 'fill' weight for a chunky, highly visible game-like style.
